prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one dialogue bust for the game Terminus. Image 1 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY sprite sheet, use the front-facing design and preserve hair, facial structure, clothing and accessories, do not copy sheet layout. Images 2 and 3 are STYLE ONLY references from Coreto (Tharok and Melia): match bold black hand-inked contours, angular cartoon fantasy faces, limited parchment ochre/sepia colors, dense fine black stippling and crosshatching in shadows. Image 4 is Ghork, the companion bust: match its finish and scale. NOT pixel art, NOT realistic painting or 3D. Single character only, complete head, ears and shoulders with comfortable margins, upper body to waist, mild three-quarter view, natural neutral dialogue pose. Actual transparent background, no ground shadow, no backdrop, no paper rectangle, no lettering, no watermark. Preserve race, age and build; no new story symbols, magic, armor or weapons absent from character reference. Neral transformed: same identifiable swept dark hairstyle and angular face as the sprite, pale adult male Ignoto alchemist now enlarged, broad distorted torso, oversized uneven muscular shoulders and elongated arms, remnants of the same open coat. Aggressive strained expression. Preserve sprite proportions and recognizable face; ONLY two arms and normal humanoid head, no horns, tentacles, new magic or gore. Image 5 is the SAME CHARACTER in disguise: retain the exact recognizable face, swept hairstyle, facial proportions and outfit vocabulary, adapted to this form. Do not draw another person. Pale skin should be noticeably lighter than brown clothing within the sepia palette.
